ty":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"world","holder":null,"opaque":false},"time":"t_death","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d6"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第15段叙述苏天晴下班吃面时胸口一疼、眼前一黑昏死过去。"}},{"id":"f_grandma_voice","at":15,"text":"苏天晴在昏死前听到太奶在背后说话，回头看见太奶坐在藤椅上悠闲地编着一只围巾。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"greatgrandma"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"unknown","reason":"原文只写太奶在背后说话，未给出说话的具体内容"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_grandma","opaque":true},"time":"t_death","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_grandma","id_su"],"proof":{"premises":["d6"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第15段写苏天晴听到太奶在背后说话并回头看见太奶编围巾，说话内容原文未给出。"}},{"id":"f_rebirth","at":25,"text":"苏天晴认为自己重生成了镜中那只金毛狐女。","predicate":"pr_reborn_as","arguments":[{"role":"person","value":{"type":"ref","id":"su"}},{"role":"body","value":{"type":"ref","id":"fox_body"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"belief","holder":"e_su","opaque":true},"time":"t_present","quantifier":"particular","modality":"actual","conditions":[],"textualConditions":[],"exceptions":[],"identities":["id_su","id_foxbody"],"proof":{"premises":["d11","d3"],"method":"direct","certainty":"accepted","rationale":"第24-25段为苏天晴的想法“我重生了，重生成了一只金毛狐女”，配合第7-11段镜中所见的狐女身影。"}},{"id":"f_book_intro","at":30,"text":"黑色古书自称名为墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找它最优秀的适格者，并告诉苏天晴那个人就是她。","predicate":"pr_speak","arguments":[{"role":"speaker","value":{"type":"ref","id":"book"}},{"role":"addressee","value":{"type":"ref","id":"su"}},{"role":"content","value":{"type":"text","text":"吾名墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找我最优秀的适格者。而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。"}}],"polarity":"affirmative","assertion":{"kind":"speech","holder":"e_book","
